title: Run Result Read Contract for Observe Source v1
description: Layout rule v2: walk .fgos/assignments lexically to depth 16. A runs directory marks its parent as an assignment; its relative assignment id may contain /. Read only direct runs/<attempt>/result.json children and optional sibling run.json settlement metadata, never descend into attempts or follow symlinks. assignment.json is optional, with absent/unreadable/symlink metadata yielding null role and adapter. Inline unit records with unitRunId but no runId are skipped as inline-record. Coverage counts missing-result, unparseable, no-run-id, no-timestamp, invalid-timestamp, symlink, duplicate-run-id and depth skips; traversal barriers count one skipped candidate, preserving observed + skipped = runDirsSeen.

result.description: Fields read from a regular parseable result.json. Observed records require a runId string that is nonblank after trimming, preserving its original text. Observation time is the first nonblank string from result.settledAt, result.timestamp, then regular parseable sibling run.json.settledAt; the first nonblank settlement string must be a valid RFC3339 instant, otherwise the run is skipped as invalid-timestamp and does not fall through to a later field; startedAt, assignment.createdAt and filesystem mtime are never used. Lexical traversal retains the first otherwise eligible record for a duplicate runId before consumer window filtering. Absent results are missing-result; present unreadable, invalid JSON or nonregular results are unparseable; result symlinks are symlink.

runId.description: Identifier of the run, used verbatim as subject id; whitespace-only strings are not admitted.

settledAt.description: Primary observation timestamp when a nonblank string.

timestamp.description: Observation timestamp when result.settledAt is absent, non-string or blank.

assignmentId.description: Historical record field; the observation assignmentId is the assignment directory's relative path beneath assignments and may contain /.

run.description: Optional sibling run.json, read only if neither result timestamp field supplies a nonblank string. Missing, unreadable, invalid JSON, nonregular or symlink metadata supplies no fallback timestamp and never hides an otherwise eligible primary result.

settledAt.description: Final observation timestamp fallback when nonblank; preserved verbatim.

assignment.description: Optional assignment.json metadata read once per assignment; never follows a symlink. It is not required to observe a run.
